title: First-run checklist & step-matrix illustrations for onboarding landing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable first-run checklist and an accompanying step-matrix illustration for the Quickstart landing page. The goal is to reduce cognitive load for new developer signups by making the onboarding path predictable: account -> API key -> sample request -> view results -> iterate. Deliverables include responsive hero-level artwork, a modular step matrix for docs and marketing, and 3 annotated screenshots showing progressive configuration states.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist copy fits a single responsive row on desktop and stacks cleanly on mobile
Step-matrix illustration exported in SVG and PNG at 1x, 2x and 3x for doc/marketing use
Three annotated screenshots (empty state, example request, completed result) with live token/cost overlay mock
Design tokens used (colors/typography) match design system and include high-contrast variant for AA accessibility
Figma file contains componentized checklist and a copy-ready handoff page with specs and redlines
PRD and Figma links included in ticket; UX review completed and PM sign-off obtained
tasks: Audit current quickstart visuals and existing hero assets
Sketch 4 checklist concepts and 2 step-matrix directions
Refine chosen directions and produce responsive layouts for 3 breakpoints
Create annotated screenshots using staging data and include token/cost overlay
Run accessibility contrast checks and adjust color tokens
Prepare Figma handoff page and export assets for docs and marketing
Collect PM/Engineering feedback and iterate (2 rounds)
Create GitHub PR for updated docs screenshots and reference assets
design_notes: Prioritize scannability: each checklist item should be an action (verb-first) and include a micro-progress indicator
Step-matrix should be neutral about deployment mode but allow quick swap of badges (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
Use simplified SVG motifs for terminals, keys, request/response, and results to keep illustration language consistent
Avoid over-branding in docs versions; reserve decorative treatments for marketing hero only
Consider motion keyframe for interactive checklist on landing (prototype in Figma)
Use real sample prompts but redact PII; show token breakout in small caption
